description: Find events Sentry dropped before storing them (SDK sampling, filters, rate limits, quota, spike protection), as dropped and accepted volume over time by outcome and reason. Each drop is tagged intentional (sampling, filters) or unintentional (quota, abuse). Use it to explain flat, low, or missing data that searches, charts, and dashboards cannot show; no drops means the data is complete.

dataset.description: Data type to report drops for.

anyOf.description: Bucket size such as 1h or 1d, at most 1d. Omit to let Sentry pick.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: Only count drops of this kind; accepted volume is always returned in full.
The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.
Only count drops with this sub-cause of an outcome, such as key_quota, sample_rate, or spike_protection.
The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.
Relative time range such as 24h or 7d. Do not combine with start and end.

name: find_dropped_events
title: Find Dropped Events
